research_unlock_fertilizer_blurb: Synthetic fertilizer costs less money than a Fertilizer bag and holds more fertilizer per bag. Fruit grown in soil that had Synthetic fertilizer added is not organic.
research_unlock_tomato_blurb: Sow Tomato on tilled soil. It takes longer than Wheat and is more picky about water and fertilizer range, but the market pays more for Tomato than for Wheat. Harvest soon as ripe Tomato loses freshness faster than Potato.
research_unlock_grape_blurb: Sow Grape on tilled soil. It drinks more than Wheat and loses freshness sooner than Potato, and the market pays more for Grape than for Wheat.
research_unlock_raspberry_blurb: Sow Raspberry on tilled soil. The market pays more for Raspberry than for Tomato or Grape, but it takes longer to ripen and ripe fruit loses freshness faster than Tomato or Grape. Harvest the day it ripens.
research_unlock_crop_variants_blurb: A happy plant can ripen as Uncommon, Rare, or Heirloom instead of the rarity of the seed you sowed, and that fruit sells for more at the market. A plant that is thirsty, too wet, or starving for fertilizer can yield lower rarity fruit.
research_unlock_heirloom_blurb: The Seed silo and the Shop show Heirloom. Heirloom fruit sells for more at the market than Rare fruit of the same crop, and that plant wants the tightest water and fertilizer range.
research_unlock_expand_blurb: You can Expand onto ground that touches land you already own. Each Expand spends one expansion permit and still costs money.
research_unlock_pickaxe_blurb: A Pickaxe mines Rock into ground you can till, and mines Very hard soil into Infertile soil that a Shovel cannot. The Hardened pickaxe lasts longer and mines faster than a Pickaxe.
research_expand_land_blurb: One more expansion permit. You can Expand one more time. The land still costs money on top of the expansion permit.
research_eminent_domain_blurb: A third expansion permit. You can Expand one more time. The land still costs money on top of the expansion permit.
research_unlock_landscaping_blurb: Sow Grass seeds on tilled soil to turn a plot back into Grass. Wooden fence marks a boundary you still walk through. Paving slab, Brickwork, and Cobblestone lay on untilled ground and keep the garden walkable.
research_unlock_irrigation_blurb: Place a Tap next to tilled soil so you stop walking back to the Pump. Pipe carries water from the Pump to that Tap.
research_unlock_water_storage_blurb: A Well gathers water that costs no money at the end of the day, unlike a Pump. Place a Pumpjack when one Pump's tank runs short.
research_unlock_auto_irrigation_blurb: A Sprinkler waters every growing plot in its area, so you stop carrying a Bucket to each one. A Valve sits on a Pipe so you can Close valve on that Pipe and leave the rest of the water network open.
research_unlock_adv_irrigation_blurb: A Vertical sprinkler waters a long strip of plots. A Large sprinkler waters a wider area than a Sprinkler, so one Large sprinkler covers more plots and you lay less Pipe.
research_unlock_sensors_blurb: Open Sensors in the Lens menu to run a wire. Flip a Lever to send a signal by hand, or let a sensor watch a plot, so a Sprinkler or a Valve can act while you garden.
research_unlock_advanced_sensors_blurb: AND gate, OR gate, and NOT gate combine signals so a Sprinkler or a Valve can wait on more than one signal, or run only while another signal is off.
research_unlock_smart_irrigation_blurb: Tune sprinkler to a crop so it pours only what that crop consumes, not Full flow, which stops drowning plants. Wire a signal into a Sprinkler to turn the pour on and off, or into a Valve so the click reads Valve - wired and the signal opens and closes that Pipe.
research_unlock_vehicles_blurb: Place a Vehicle hangar, then buy a Quad or a Tractor there. Drive a Quad to carry items across the farm without walking. Attach a Seeder, Sprayer, or Harvester to a Tractor to sow, spray, or harvest a strip while you drive.
research_unlock_dispatch_blurb: A Quad or Tractor can run automated on a route, so you garden while it sows, sprays, or unloads. Automate starts that run from the Vehicle hangar. A Traffic light holds a vehicle only while that light is a stop on the route.
research_unlock_silos_blurb: Place a Seeding silo, Spraying silo, or Produce silo on the field so a Tractor on a route can load and unload there instead of driving back to the House. Walking up shows the name only.
research_unlock_contracts_blurb: The Market shows a Contracts tab. Accept a contract and Drop off what it named; completed contracts pay more money than the market. Missed contracts and days with none taken lower Reputation, and higher Reputation makes later contracts harder.
research_unlock_better_tools_blurb: A Better shovel tills faster than a Shovel and lasts for more uses. A Large bucket holds more water than a Bucket, so you Fill less often at the Pump.
research_unlock_chest_blurb: Place a Chest on the field and walk up to store any item. A haul sits next to the plots instead of a walk back to the House.
research_unlock_grinder_blurb: Grind fruit at a Seed grinder into seeds of the same crop and rarity, so a harvest can sow the next field without buying seeds from the Shop. Crush fruit and Cut grass at a Mill into goods the market pays more for than the fruit.
research_unlock_preservatives_blurb: Make jam from fruit and Sugar; the market pays more for jam than for the fruit, and jam does not lose freshness. A Freezer holds fruit so it rots slower than in a Chest. Sugar is sold by the bag in the Shop.
research_unlock_fermentation_blurb: Sow Sugar cane; ripe cane is fruit that drinks more water than Wheat and sells for less at the market, and a Mill crushes it into Sugar. A Pot still distills a batch into spirits. A Barrel turns Grape into Wine and Apple into Cider.
research_unlock_furnace_blurb: Burn a mixed load into Ash. A working Furnace makes nearby machines finish faster than they do without one.
research_grant_rarity_rolls: Happy plants can ripen a different rarity than the seed
research_grant_silo_rows: Uncommon and Rare rows in the Seed silo
research_grant_heirloom_column: Heirloom row in the Seed silo and the Shop
research_grant_hangar_stock: Quad, Tractor, Seeder, Sprayer, and Harvester at the Vehicle hangar
research_grant_rep_decay: Reputation falls on a day with no contract taken
